image_description: A red, multi-bottom moldboard plow resting on a gravel surface. The implement features a long horizontal toolbar painted red, supporting four distinct plow bottoms. Each bottom consists of a curved, metallic moldboard and share assembly, appearing weathered with soil residue. A blue and yellow vertical component is visible at the rear left (likely a marker or depth wheel assembly). The background shows a blurred rural landscape with trees and a building.
